mapper.select: SELECT vote_id, meeting_id, participant_id, candidate_id, vote_type, vote_change_count, created_at, updated_at FROM place_votes WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND participant_id = #{participantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_votes ( meeting_id, participant_id, candidate_id, vote_type, vote_change_count ) VALUES ( #{meetingId}, #{participantId}, #{candidateId}, #{voteType}, #{voteChangeCount} )
mapper.select:
SELECT mc.candidate_id AS candidateId, mc.place_name AS placeName, COUNT(pv.vote_id) AS voteCount FROM meeting_candidates mc
LEFT JOIN place_votes pv ON mc.candidate_id = pv.candidate_id AND pv.meeting_id = #{meetingId}
WHERE mc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND mc.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY mc.candidate_id, mc.place_name
ORDER BY voteCount DESC, mc.candidate_id ASC

SELECT pv.candidate_id AS candidateId, mp.participant_id AS participantId, u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname
FROM place_votes pv
JOIN meeting_participants mp ON pv.participant_id = mp.participant_id AND pv.meeting_id = mp.meeting_id
JOIN users u ON mp.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN meeting_candidates mc ON pv.candidate_id = mc.candidate_id AND pv.meeting_id = mc.meeting_id AND mc.is_active = TRUE
WHERE pv.meeting_id = #{meetingId}
ORDER BY pv.updated_at ASC, pv.vote_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_votes WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND vote_type = 'ABSTAIN'
